description:
Look up the NFPA 704 fire diamond ratings for three chemicals on CAMEO Chemicals (https://cameochemicals.noaa.gov/) and compile a structured safety report. The chemicals are: 1) Acrolein, 2) Sodium Chlorate, and 3) Toluene.

For each chemical, find the Health, Flammability, and Instability numerical ratings (0-4) and any Special Hazard codes (e.g., OX, W, SA). Then, determine the 'Area Maximum' for a shared storage area by taking the highest number in each category across all three chemicals, and listing ALL applicable special hazards.

Create a report file at '/home/ga/Desktop/nfpa_report.txt' using the exact format below:

NFPA 704 Storage Area Assessment
=================================

Chemical: Acrolein
Health: [value]
Flammability: [value]
Instability: [value]
Special: [value or NONE]

Chemical: Sodium Chlorate
Health: [value]
Flammability: [value]
Instability: [value]
Special: [value or NONE]

Chemical: Toluene
Health: [value]
Flammability: [value]
Instability: [value]
Special: [value or NONE]

Area Maximum Ratings
Health: [max value]
Flammability: [max value]
Instability: [max value]
Special: [combined specials or NONE]
